obligations.description: Report open questions that appear in some runs of one task file but not others.
obligations.evidence_rationale: Decompose-stage case: the hook parses the task file and stops, so no test was ever examined for this obligation. `unsupported` is the accurate class for that and no evidence assertion is made on these cases. A dropped requirement is invisible downstream — no later stage can evidence a requirement that was never extracted. Splitting the bullet fixed it at source and run 5 extracts both.
